highlights.title: Arcee's new, open source Trinity-Large-Thinking is the rare, powerful U.S.-made AI model that enterprises can download and customize
highlights.description: The baton of open source AI models has been passed on between several companies over the years since ChatGPT debuted in late 2022, from Meta with its Llama family to Chinese labs like Qwen and z.ai. But lately, Chinese companies have started pivoting back towards proprietary models even as some U.S. labs like Cursor and Nvidia release their own variants of the Chinese models, leaving a question mark about who will originate this branch of technology going forward. highlights.title: Japan's Sakura Internet jumps 20% as Microsoft plans $10 billion AI push with SoftBank
highlights.description: Microsoft said it plans to invest $10 billion in Japan between 2026 and 2029 to build AI infrastructure.

highlights.title: Microsoft Charts $10 Billion of Outlays in AI-Eager Japan
highlights.description: Microsoft Corp. unveiled a four-year, $10 billion investment package for Japan, a major pillar of its Asia-wide artificial intelligence push.

highlights.title: Chinese Robot Pioneer UBTech Offers $18 Million for AI Scientist
highlights.description: Chinese humanoid robot maker UBTech Robotics Corp. is seeking a chief scientist, offering an annual pay of as much as 124 million yuan ($18 million) in an aggressive bet on an industry where product applications are still at an early stage.

highlights.title: Microsoft executive touts Copilot sales traction as AI anxiety weighs on stock
highlights.description: Analysts have said adoption of the $30-per-month Microsoft 365 Copilot is in the early stage.

highlights.title: Apple sets Q2 2026 earnings release for April 30
highlights.description: Apple will announce the results of its fiscal second quarter of 2026 on Thursday, April 30. Here’s what to expect. more…

highlights.title: Apple details plan to sunset Ads Campaign Management API in 2027
highlights.description: Apple has released preview documentation for its new Ads Platform API, outlining a transition away from the existing Campaign Management API. Here are the details. more…

highlights.title: Todd Blanche, author of DOJ crypto enforcement memo, is now interim AG
highlights.description: U.S. President Donald Trump named Todd Blanche, his former personal attorney and deputy attorney general, as the interim top prosecutor.
